name: ELOcho - Pre-3
author: RolandoGarroMena
description:
I wrote this game while working as a server in a Mexican Restaurant in Fort Walton, I finished modeling the Huey Helicopter like if it were my server tray.One Day flying the surfkite I found a vacuum zone above of a rattle snake nest, this happened to me the day after a Vietnam veteran gave me a $5 tip. I sent my resume to Lockheed while writing this microgame. Shalimar Blues I need an iRig midi keyboard. You can download the Huey model https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/huey-bell-205-uh1-8dc476ac29f94ce39bd907849e5692e8
